title: CrowdWorks Multi-Agent RAG System
summary: An industry collaboration exploring agent-based research and hybrid retrieval for food-industry information.
image_alt: Illustration of the research assistant interface and report generation
image_caption: Project UI mockup from the repository.
overview: Developed as a Korea University–CrowdWorks industry collaboration, the project brings together dispersed food-industry information in a research-assistant workflow. Its design combines multiple agents with graph and vector retrieval to support complex questions.
features: Hybrid retrieval combines graph relationships with semantic search.
A LangGraph-based workflow coordinates data gathering and report generation.
The interface presents the research process and source references.
role: Team lead; data preprocessing, embedding design, and Vector RAG development, as described in the project repository.
figure_alt: Architecture diagram of the CrowdWorks multi-agent retrieval system
figure_caption: System architecture from the project repository.

title: plinq
summary: An AI-assisted workspace for meetings, tasks, and project collaboration.
image_alt: plinq project interface showing meeting summaries and action items
image_caption: Project interface shown under its earlier development name, Plow.
overview: plinq is an AI-assisted meeting and project management platform submitted to the 2026 Korea University College of Informatics NE:XT Contest. The repository is a submission snapshot containing the desktop application, backend, AI pipeline, and web components.
features: Meeting transcripts can be organized into summaries and suggested action items.
Project work is organized through task, backlog, and calendar views.
The system includes a desktop client, a database layer, and an AI pipeline.
role: Planning and development; team representative, according to the submission repository.

title: College of Informatics Student Council Website
summary: A web front end for student council information and services at Korea University.
image_alt: College of Informatics shield graphic from the student council website
image_caption: College of Informatics graphic from the website assets.
overview: A web front end for the Korea University College of Informatics student council. The repository includes pages for student council information and interfaces for student services and administration.
features: Student council information and activity pages.
Booking and locker interfaces, with corresponding administration pages.
Separate user and administrator session routes.
role: Chair of the student council website development task force.

title: Trabuddy
summary: A travel assistant app designed to help travelers navigate unfamiliar situations abroad.
image_caption: Project logo from the Trabuddy repository.
overview: Trabuddy is a mobile travel assistant developed for the 2025 Google Solution Challenge. The project explores how an AI companion can help travelers prepare for and respond to situations during trips abroad.
features: Travel preparation information and checklists.
Translation and conversation support.
Travel information and chat history interfaces.
role: UI/UX design and frontend development, as listed in the project README.

title: KU Agent Lab
summary: An interactive learning site for AI agent concepts, demonstrations, and hands-on exercises.
image_alt: Title slide from the AI Agent development workshop
image_caption: A slide from the AI Agent workshop materials.
overview: KU Agent Lab is a lecture and workshop site for exploring AI agent development. It brings course materials, demonstrations, and an interactive workspace together in one place.
features: An AI agent workshop with staged demonstrations and a browser-based workspace.
Lecture materials with slide navigation and downloadable resources.
An exercise and leaderboard workflow.

title: Student Council Ordering
summary: A web ordering interface for an event, featuring menus and table-based orders.
image_alt: A menu photo from the ordering project assets
image_caption: A menu photograph from the project assets.
overview: An event ordering frontend built with Next.js. The code includes a menu interface, quantity selection, an order summary, and a table-specific ordering route.
features: Menu and drink selection with quantity controls.
An order summary and table-specific ordering flow.
A route for forwarding order requests.

title: ReaLton
summary: A prototype exploring AI-assisted spoke-guard design for wheelchair users.
image_alt: Decorative illustration inspired by a wheelchair spoke guard
image_caption: Illustration created for this page; the repository did not include a project screenshot.
overview: ReaLton explores the use of generative AI to help wheelchair users express their preferences through spoke-guard designs. The repository describes an interface for selecting visual styles and colors and generating design prompts.
features: A selection interface for colors and visual styles.
Text input for describing a desired design.
An AI-assisted prompt generation flow described in the source.

title: KUconut
summary: A campus-life web frontend organized around activities, food, study, and more.
image_caption: Illustration created for this page; the repository did not include a project screenshot.
overview: KUconut is a campus-life web frontend with sections for activities, food, study, and other experiences. The repository contains the React application and its page structure.
features: Separate Eat, Play, Study, and Extra sections.
Pages for exploring, filtering, and creating entries.
A personal page and navigation across categories.
